Explain why rendering a complex3D scene can benefit from a GPU and substantial RAM

markscheme.marking_summary: Many similar pixel/geometry calculations can be processed in parallel on the GPU. RAM holds working geometry,textures and scene data. Insufficient available memory can require more transfers or constrain scene detail,so balanced processing and memory capacity matter.

mappings.scope_evidence:
• The architecture that allows graphics processing units (GPUs) to handle specific tasks and makes them suitable for complex computations
• Real-world scenarios may include video games, artificial intelligence (AI), large simulations and other applications that require graphics rendering and machine learning.
mappings.rationale: Explain why rendering a complex3D scene can benefit from a GPU and substantial RAM assesses Describe the role of a GPU.

mappings.scope_evidence:
• Random-access memory (RAM), read only memory (ROM), cache (L1, L2, L3), registers
• The interaction of the CPU with different types of memory to optimize performance
• The relevance of the terms “cache miss” and “cache hit”
mappings.rationale: Explain why rendering a complex3D scene can benefit from a GPU and substantial RAM assesses Explain the purposes of different types of primary memory.
